description:
Moments before her execution at the Emperor's hands, Manae Frey makes a plea for their illegitimate daughter to be protected at all costs. But after a desperate pact with a mysterious monster, Manae awakens to find she now inhabits her young daughter’s body. Given a second chance as Lilina, Manae resolves to seize the life her daughter was denied — and prove to the Calvaria Empire that she’s more than just a forgotten child. She will claim her place as a true princess, no matter what it takes!

(Source: Tapas)
